fix: Stop allocating a Vec<f32> per kept row. Add a non-allocating accessor to MeasuredExtentIndex in crates/incular-scroll/src/extent_index.rs, e.g. `pub fn edges(&self, index: usize) -> (f32, f32)`, and use `let (start, end) = self.index.edges(index); children.push(self.variable_child_layout(index, start, end, constraints));` at lines 437-438 and 446-447.

offsets_for_range (crates/incular-scroll/src/extent_index.rs:405) returns a fresh Vec<f32> on every layout. Keep a scratch `offsets: Vec<f32>` field on VariableExtentRenderSliver, take it with std::mem::take, fill it through a buffer-taking variant (`offsets_for_range_into(range, &mut Vec<f32>)`, the private helper at extent_index.rs:224 already has this shape), then put it back. Clear and reuse it each layout.

Per layout this builds `kept`, then `leading` and `trailing` through partition (lines 426-434) and allocates a fresh Vec each frame whenever keep-alive rows exist. Store `kept: Vec<usize>` as a scratch field, `clear()` and `extend(self.widgets.keys().copied().filter(|i| !range.contains(i)))`, `sort_unstable()`, then `let split = kept.partition_point(|i| *i < range.start);` and iterate `kept[..split]` as leading and `kept[split..]` as trailing. Take the field with std::mem::take while building children, then restore it.

GridRenderSliver::perform_layout rebuilds a SizedBox wrapper per cell (lines 300-312), a Row or Column per row (lines 316-318) and a SliverChildLayout per row on every layout, which runs on every scroll frame. Cache the wrapped cell Widget next to its child in `widgets`, and cache each row widget, keyed by (row, columns, main_extent, cross_spacing, cell_cross_extent, axis). Rebuild only when the key changes, and store the key on the sliver.

Use one hash lookup on the miss path: `self.widgets.entry(index).or_insert_with(|| (self.builder)(index)).clone()`. The same get-then-insert pattern repeats in GridRenderSliver::child_widget (lines 238-243) and VariableExtentRenderSliver::child_widget (lines 371-376), so apply it to all three.
